results.title: Gibwork Developer Hackathon Bounty
results.content: Join this Gibwork Developer Hackathon bounty to create a new non-web-app use case for Gibwork using the SDK, CLI, or MCP. This bounty is focused on practical developer workflows, automations, integrations, or tooling that demonstrate a compelling way Gibwork can be used outside of traditional web applications.Bounty DescriptionThe selected participants will be responsible for:Designing and building a new Gibwork bounty use case that uses the SDK, CLI, or MCP in a meaningful and functional way.Focusing this bounty on non-web-app development, such as developer tooling, automation flows, terminal-based utilities, AI agent integrations, backend workflows, local productivity tools, or other creative bounty concepts.Implementing a working prototype that clearly shows how the bounty use case works, what problem it solves, and how Gibwork is integrated.Documenting the bounty solution so another developer can understand the setup, usage flow, and expected output.Providing a short demo of the completed bounty build, including the core workflow and successful execution.RequirementsThe bounty must use Gibwork SDK, CLI, or MCP as a core part of the implementation.The bounty must be a new use case, not a minor variation of an existing demo.The bounty must not be a web app, frontend dashboard, or browser-based product.The bounty should solve a real developer, operations, automation, research, or workflow problem with a clear practical outcome.The bounty submission must include clear setup instructions, dependencies, and steps to run or test the project.The submission should be functional, organized, and understandable enough for basic reviewer validation.Must attend at least 2 of the hackathon sessions on Discord.What to SubmitA public GitHub repository URL for the completed bounty project, including all source code and a README.A short written summary in the repository README or shared document explaining the bounty use case, why it is valuable, and which Gibwork toolset was used (SDK, CLI, or MCP).Setup and usage instructions for the bounty project, including installation steps, environment variables, commands to run, and sample input/output.A screen recording or demo video URL showing the bounty workflow from setup or execution through successful output.Screenshots of the bounty project running, such as terminal output, logs, agent interactions, or generated results.Any exported deliverables produced by the bounty project, such as output files, reports, generated artifacts, or shared document links, if applicable.How to startSubmit to the Google form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSejpks7hItR6zBUXpdrwgUDrwvEcmnJj6nlFbUXKIyNkVVfag/viewform?usp=dialogCheck Discord (https://discord.gg/2577tTsRt) to see if you have been rewarded the Hackathon role.Once rewarded the Discord role you can start the work.

results.title: Invite Users, Earn Points, and Climb the Leaderboard
results.content:
Invite people to Gibwork and earn points when they accept your referral and participate in a bounty, connect a qualifying X account, and create funded bounties. Compete for a 125.00 USDC reward pool and follow your progress on our shared leaderboard.
How to participate

Submit “I want to participate” or any other message to this bounty to enter.
Find your referral link at gib.work/referrals and share it with people you invite. If they download the Gibwork app, make sure they enter your referral code in the app so their referral is attributed to you.
Make sure they accept your referral on Gibwork and participate in any bounty to earn the base referral point. Clicking your link, downloading the app or accepting your referral alone does not earn that point.
Follow your referral counts, points and rank in the Google Sheets leaderboard.

Points breakdown

Accepts your referral on Gibwork and participates in any bounty: +1
Connects an X account that is X verified and has more than 500 followers: +4 bonus
Creates and successfully funds a new public Gibwork bounty with an initial reward pool of more than 50 USDC, excluding fees: +20 bonus

Bonuses stack: one referred user can earn you up to 25 points. Each milestone counts once per referred user. Additional bounties by that same user do not earn extra creator bonuses.
Example: Refer 5 eligible users who each accept your referral and participate in a bounty. If 2 qualify for the X bonus and 1 qualifies for the funded-bounty bonus, you earn 5 + (2 × 4) + 20 = 33 points.
What counts

Referral attribution must be recorded after this bounty is created and before its deadline. If you enter later, eligible referrals from that same campaign window still count.
The base referral point requires a recorded submission to any bounty after referral acceptance and before the campaign deadline. Each referred user earns this point only once, regardless of how many bounties they participate in.
X and funded-bounty bonuses must qualify after referral acceptance and before the deadline. X eligibility must be observed and recorded during the campaign.
Each referred person counts once. Self-referrals, duplicate accounts and previously attributed referrals do not qualify.
The X bonus requires all three conditions: a connected X account, X verification and at least 501 followers. Gibwork verification alone does not satisfy this bonus.
The bounty bonus requires a newly created, successfully funded public bounty. Drafts, failed funding, top-ups to older bounties and pools of exactly 50 USDC do not qualify. Cancelled or refunded bounties before final review do not earn the bonus.

Tracking and rewards
We will manually review Gibwork referral records and qualifying activity, then update the leaderboard. Updates are periodic, not live; check the sheet's last-updated time. Newly earned points may remain pending until reviewed.
You must earn at least 25 confirmed points to be considered for a reward. The reward rate is 25 points = 5.00 USDC ($5.00), equivalent to 0.20 USDC per point. For an eligible participant whose points pass final review, 25 points earns 5.00 USDC, 50 points earns 10.00 USDC, and 100 points earns 20.00 USDC.
Submitting a message enrolls you in the campaign; it does not guarantee a reward. Scores remain provisional until final review. These are gross reward amounts before any applicable payout fees.
Reward pool: 125.00 USDC
Minimum score for consideration: 25 confirmed points
Reward rate: 25 points = 5.00 USDC
Minimum payout: 5.00 USDC
Deadline: October 14, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. EDT (20:00 UTC).

results.title: Invite a UGC Creator to Gibwork and Get a Reply — $30.00
results.content:
Find a UGC creator who would be a strong fit for the Gibwork mobile app video bounty. Send them a personal DM inviting them to participate and get a response.
Choose someone based on their actual videos and ability to create engaging, original short-form content.
Who to look for
A creator with examples of high-quality UGC videos, ideally app demos, product walkthroughs, or explainers.Clear visuals, understandable voiceover or on-screen text, and an authentic presentation style.Ability to show the Gibwork mobile app and explain how it works.A verified X account with at least 800 followers, matching the linked bounty's current participation settings.
What to do
Review the creator's work and choose someone who fits.Send a personalized X DM explaining why you chose them. Include the linked video bounty and its reward: $25 base for approved videos, plus $1.50 per 1,000 views, subject to that bounty's terms.Get a relevant reply from the creator. A sent message alone does not qualify.
The reply must address your invitation—for example, expressing interest, asking a question, or declining. Automated replies, message reactions, and read receipts do not count. The creator does not need to complete a video for this outreach submission to qualify.
Example of a good referral
In the previous referral bounty, the winning submission by siam_1205 referred @dibNotanu. It included the creator's profile, video example 1, video example 2, an explanation of how the creator's previous video campaigns and content quality made her a fit, and an outreach proof screenshot.
Use this as a model for the quality and completeness of your referral. Find a new creator; do not resubmit @dibNotanu or copy the previous submission or its proof.
What to submit
The creator's X profile URL.Links to at least two relevant videos they created.A short explanation of why they fit the video bounty.Screenshots showing your sent invitation, the creator's reply, their X handle, and message dates. Expand messages so the full exchange is readable; use multiple screenshots if needed.
Hide unrelated conversations and private information. Do not submit yourself, fabricate proof, send bulk spam, or claim to represent the Gibwork team.
Reward pool: 30.00 USDC total. Minimum payout: 3.00 USDC per approved submission meeting these requirements. This outreach reward is separate from the creator's video bounty reward.
